name: Translating the Journal
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 3,450 experience instead of 700, 4.93 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details: At an impasse of sorts, you know that you will need the book translated into a language you can understand.  There certainly are a number of people in the world who could do it; the closest location that might have someone who could, however, is the Kargath outpost in the Badlands.  Perhaps that is a good place to start.
narrative.objectives: Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal.  The closest location that might have someone is Kargath, in the Badlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Mighty champion, I know what you are doing out here in the Badlands. I know you seek my gift of tongues. You're after the parts to that necklace you found in Uldaman.Surprised? Don't be - it's my job to know such things. Instead, let's discuss what you're going to do for a translated journal. Trust me - I'm the only one you'll find that can translate it.Better still, let me make you a better offer than Dran Droffers is, and it'll let you still complete your deal with them. Interested now, yes?

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 41 to 44, 19,900 XP in all.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery
quests.objectiveText: Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 2
quests.objectiveText: Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.

quests.name: Translating the Journal
quests.objectiveText: Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal.

quests.name: Find the Gems and Power Source
quests.objectiveText: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.

quests.name: Deliver the Gems
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Necklace and Gem Salvage to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 3
quests.objectiveText: Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.
